name: MailGame
description: Interactive web app simulating sending and receiving digital letters in real time
fullDescription: Developed a full-stack interactive application that gamifies digital communication through real-time mail delivery between users. Built with Next.js, Firebase, and Phaser for dynamic animations, MailGame combines creativity, messaging, and instant feedback in a single responsive platform.
features: Real-time digital mail delivery and user interaction
Firebase authentication and Firestore data persistence
Optimized for Vercel deployment and SSR
